Running command: cd /workspace && rm -rf /tmp/glog-instr && cp -r repo-vul/src-vul/glog /tmp/glog-instr && cd /tmp/glog-instr && mkdir -p src/glog && cat > src/config.h <<'EOF'
#ifndef GLOG_CONFIG_H
#define GLOG_CONFIG_H
#define GOOGLE_NAMESPACE google
#define _START_GOOGLE_NAMESPACE_ namespace google {
#define _END_GOOGLE_NAMESPACE_ }
#define GLOG_EXPORT
#define NO_THREADS 1
#define HAVE_STDINT_H 1
#define HAVE_SYS_TYPES_H 1
#define HAVE_UNISTD_H 1
#define HAVE_INTTYPES_H 1
#define SIZEOF_VOID_P 8
#define STL_NAMESPACE std
#endif
EOF
sed 's/@ac_cv_have_stdint_h@/1/g; s/@ac_cv_have_systypes_h@/1/g; s/@ac_cv_have_uint16_t@/1/g; s/@ac_cv_have_u_int16_t@/0/g; s/@ac_cv_have___uint16@/0/g; s/@ac_cv_have_uint32_t@/1/g; s/@ac_cv_have_u_int32_t@/0/g; s/@ac_cv_have___uint32@/0/g; s/@ac_cv_have_uint64_t@/1/g; s/@ac_cv_have_u_int64_t@/0/g; s/@ac_cv_have___uint64@/0/g; s/@ac_cv_have_inttypes_h@/1/g; s/@ac_cv_have_libgflags@/0/g; s/@ac_cv___attribute__@/1/g; s/@ac_cv___builtin_expect@/1/g; s/@ac_google_start_namespace@/namespace google {/g; s/@ac_google_end_namespace@/}/g; s/@ac_google_namespace@/google/g' repo-vul/src-vul/glog/src/glog/logging.h.in > src/glog/logging.h || true
cat > /tmp/fuzz_main.cc <<'EOF'
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include "demangle.h"
int main(int argc,char**argv){if(argc<2)return 0; FILE*f=fopen(argv[1],"rb"); if(!f){perror("fopen"); return 1;} unsigned char data[5000]; size_t sz=fread(data,1,sizeof(data),f); fclose(f); if(sz>=4095)return 0; char Buffer[sz+1]; memcpy(Buffer,data,sz); Buffer[sz]=0; char demangled[4096]; bool r=google::Demangle(Buffer,demangled,sz); printf("r=%d out=%s\n",r,demangled); return 0;}
EOF
g++ -std=c++17 -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -Isrc -Isrc/glog /tmp/fuzz_main.cc src/demangle.cc -o /tmp/fuzz_demangle_local && echo OK && printf _Z1fv > /tmp/t && /tmp/fuzz_demangle_local /tmp/t
